items.question: Which Douyin page types can MediaClaw scrape?
items.answer: Video detail pages, creator profile pages, and keyword search result pages. You can build your sample library through three paths: single-video deep dives, account-level benchmarking, and niche-wide scanning.

items.question: Should I scrape by account or by keyword first?
items.answer: Start with keywords to get the niche-wide landscape, then drill into top accounts for profile-level batch scraping. This gives you both macro trends and micro-level creator strategies.

items.question: How do I keep scraping speeds safe?
items.answer: Use medium speed for routine research and fast speed for urgent trend tracking. Combine with batch intervals and the built-in stall detection for a good balance of throughput and stability.

items.question: Can MediaClaw extract video transcripts?
items.answer: Yes. After scraping a Douyin video, you can extract a transcript from the collected record. The transcript is saved back to the local record and included in CSV/Markdown export or Lark sync.

items.question: How to scrape Douyin videos without coding?
items.answer: Use the free MediaClaw Chrome extension. It's a 100% no-code Douyin scraper that lets you batch extract video links, hashtags, and engagement metrics directly to an Excel-ready file with just one click.
